description: Edit a model by operations on its elements rather than by text: setValue, rename, addMember, addConnection, addSequence (action-body items), delete, move, and the diagram-layout annotations setLayout, setRoute, setCanvas, setStyle. Targets and owners are qualified names as render_view reports them in nodes[].fqn. Returns the text edits the operations amount to, per document, and the operations refused with why; writes the files only with apply=true.

after.description: the member after which to insert, by qualified name; omitted, at the end of the body

body.description: addSequence: the nested action-body items of an if, for or while, as addSequence operations

bodyExpression.description: addMember: the body expression of a calculation or constraint member

cascade.description: delete: also delete what refers to the target instead of refusing

condition.description: addConnection (transition, succession): the guard; addSequence (if, while): the condition

declaration.description: for setLayout, setRoute, setStyle: the LSP range (0-based) of an unnamed element's declaration, as render_view reports it, in place of target

declaredIn.description: the document URI declaring the target, as render_view reports in origin.uri; omitted, the requested document

digest.description: the origin.digest render_view reported for declaredIn, so a changed document is detected

elseBody.description: addSequence (if): the items of the else branch, as addSequence operations

from.description: addConnection: the end the connection starts at

keyword.description: addSequence: the succession keyword before the item (then, first)

kind.description: setValue, rename, addMember, addConnection, addSequence, delete, move, setLayout, setRoute, setCanvas or setStyle

layout.description: setLayout: {x, y, width?, height?, collapsed?} in diagram coordinates

memberKind.description: addMember: the member's keyword (part, attribute, port, action, state, ...); addConnection: connection, interface, allocation, binding, flow, succession or transition; addSequence: the action-body item (if, for, while, assign, send, accept, perform, ...)

name.description: addMember: the member's name; addConnection: an optional name

owner.description: addMember, addConnection, addSequence: the qualified name of the owner, empty for the document; move: the new owner

ref.description: addSequence: the element the keyword refers to, by qualified name

specializes.description: addMember: qualified names of what the member specializes

style.description: setStyle: {fill?, line?, text?, font?, fontSize?, bold?, italic?}, colors as #RRGGBB

target.description: qualified name of the element the operation is about (setValue, rename, delete, move, setCanvas, and the layout operations when no declaration is given)

to.description: addConnection: the end the connection goes to

type.description: addMember, addConnection: the member's type, by qualified name

value.description: setValue: the new value expression; addMember: an initial value; addSequence: the value assigned, sent or iterated over

via.description: addSequence (send, accept): the port the message goes through

view.description: the view a layout annotation belongs to, as render_view reports in view

apply.description: write every affected file, all or none, each replaced atomically (its mode is kept, other inode metadata is not); false (the default) only returns the edits

operations.description: the operations, applied in order against the document's current text

path.description: the document the operations address, absolute or relative to the workspace root

name: apply_model_edit

applied.description: whether the edits were written to disk

changes.description: the text edits the operations amount to, per document; empty when every operation was refused

edits.description: edits to the document's current text, non-overlapping, in document order

newText.description: the text that replaces the range; empty deletes it

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)

refused.description: operations not carried out, by index, with the failure code and message (ranges inside are LSP ranges, 0-based)

version.description: the version of the document the edits apply to
